description: Build a newcomer map from caller-supplied repository facts: files grouped into areas, entry points, where the tests live, and who owns what. Returns the map only; no repository is read.

entry_points.description: Paths the caller names as entry points (optional)

files.description: Repository file paths, repo-relative, in the caller's order

owners.description: Map from path prefix to owner name (optional)

test_command.description: Command that runs the test suite, echoed into the map (optional)

name: build_onboard_map
